Operational services: enable the owner-approved backup/health/brief/log-rotation schedules using the existing operational_services implementation, with bounded cadence, retention and evidence. Do not invent an external delivery destination for briefs.

Reconcile the owner-action TODO and generated status surfaces only after live state is measured; do not erase historical evidence.
stop_conditions: Never store OAuth tokens, provider keys, refresh tokens, browser cookies or account secrets in GitHub, queue JSON, evidence, logs or chat.
Do not post, message, connect, apply, edit the LinkedIn profile, or perform any other LinkedIn account mutation without a distinct owner-approved action for that mutation.
Do not use browser automation, session-cookie extraction, CAPTCHA bypass or scraping behind authentication to obtain LinkedIn access.

Do not answer application visa/right-to-work questions inaccurately or hard-code a false generic 'No'. Do not proactively mention sponsorship in generated materials unless an application/employer explicitly asks; when explicitly asked, surface the question for an accurate owner-grounded answer.
Do not delete the legacy Chief scheduled task.
Do not reboot, sign out, suspend or power-cycle the owner's laptop.
Do not choose a VPS/final deployment topology or off-site backup vendor without owner input.
Do not activate a research provider, recruiter feed, external brief-delivery destination or tracker-vocabulary change without either existing owner authorization or a recorded owner decision.
Do not mark a built-but-not-live integration PASS solely because fixture/dry-run tests pass.
